verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm that sells professional legal services such as venture deals, IP, privacy and employment advice. It has no software UI of its own whose features an API could mirror, so API/UI parity is a category error for this kind of product. The Clerky formation workflow is a partner's platform, not a Lowenstein-shipped interface, so it does not make the axis applicable. The probe finding no OpenAPI spec is consistent with this.
